description: Regenerate ONLY the white region of a mask and leave every pixel outside it unchanged, so a product or logo stays exactly your file. The result is a lossless PNG: the preserved pixels keep their values, re-encoded. Takes image_url, a same-size black-and-white mask_url (white = redo, black = keep) and a prompt for the masked area. Synchronous; max_cost_cents caps the charge.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image to edit

mask_url.description: Public https URL of a black-and-white mask the same size as the image: WHITE is regenerated, BLACK is preserved pixel for pixel

max_cost_cents.description: The most this may cost, in cents. Set it when the user gives a budget or a price limit. Refused before anything is spent when no model fits under it, and never exceeded.

prompt.description: What to generate inside the white (masked) region

name: inpaint_image
title: Inpaint image (masked edit)
